content: Graceful shutdown consensus: srv.ListenAndServe in goroutine; signal.NotifyContext for SIGINT/SIGTERM; flip readiness state BEFORE srv.Shutdown(ctx) so probes stop routing; Shutdown waits idle-conns close then active conns with bounded timeout (5-30s); then close DB/Redis pools. Context bounds time until shutdown starts, timeout bounds drain duration — two separate constraints.
